archviz-skills 1.1.0

- Expanded support for terminal and editable workflows: added termaid terminal routing and draw.io output guidance.
- Added new reference documentation for dark mode tokens, scene contracts, and mermaid/termaid routing.
- Introduced new templates for animated bars, dashboards, and scroll-reveal in HTML, plus an Excalidraw mindmap template.
- Removed redundant research notes and legacy card/license files for a leaner skill pack.
- Updated skill boundaries to highlight draw.io mode and clarified environment-specific output strategies.
Align ClawHub and GitHub to v0.1.7. Darwin + curation self-evolution pass; cleaned duplicated packaged subtree; updated README, SKILL metadata, and changelog.
Editorial Parchment (claude-design-card lineage): format families A-D, editorial-card template, When to Use/NOT, skill boundaries, checkpoints G0-G6, pitfalls red lines. Darwin+curation pass.

Sync GitHub commit ab55bc3. Adds DESIGN.md agent-readable contract inspired by awesome-design-md, fixes Warm Paper contrast tokens, updates Mermaid templates/examples, and includes stacked/area chart additions plus responsive dependency updates.

Version 1.0.0 of archviz-skills introduces a comprehensive, text-first information visualization skill pack for AI agents:

- Supports a wide array of diagram/visualization types: Mermaid, ASCII, HTML, Python (Plotly), and Three.js for 3D archviz.
- Enforces design restraint: limited palette (no rainbow/purple), concise labels, and anti-slop defaults.
- Includes detailed quick-reference for type selection, environment-aware output routing, and degradation strategies.
- 3D mode activates only for explicit spatial briefs (building, floorplan, walkthrough) with Three.js/CDN templates.
- Each visualization starts with a brief read, followed by adjustment of three "dials": COMPLEXITY, DENSITY, RESTRAINT.  
- Designed for clean, preview-compatible diagrams—never flowchart-for-everything, never pie, always contextually appropriate.
